definitions.explanation: A word or set of words by which a person, place, or thing is known. More literary than {名前|なまえ}.
One's standing or repute among others. Often used in expressions about fame or honor.

examples.japanese: ⟦お→お：03097_o⟧{名|な}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦おっしゃいますか→おっしゃる：01299_ossharu⟧。
examples.notes: Polite way to ask someone's name

examples.japanese: {名|な}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれて→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I responded when my name was called.

examples.japanese: {名|な}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{道端|みちばた}→道端：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Unknown flowers are blooming by the roadside.
examples.notes: {名|な}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ = nameless, unknown

examples.japanese: {名|な}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げた→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He's an athlete who has made a name for himself.
examples.notes: {名|な}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧ = to make a name for oneself

examples.english: He is known throughout the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{名|な}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧⟦ような→よう：01114_you⟧⟦{偉大|いだい}→偉大：01798_idai⟧な⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He was a great figure who left his mark on history.
examples.notes: {名|な}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧ = to leave one's mark

notes:
USAGE: {名|な} is more literary and formal than ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧. It's commonly used in set expressions and idioms about names and reputation.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{名|な}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧ (to make a name for oneself)
・{名|な}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧ (to be known, famous)
・{名|な}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧ (to leave one's mark)
・{名|な}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (nameless, unknown)
・{名|な}ばかり (in name only)
・{名|な}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧ (to borrow someone's name)

COMPOUNDS:
・⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧ (name - common word)
・⟦{氏名|しめい}→氏名：04033_shimei⟧ (full name - formal)
・⟦{名字|みょうじ}→名字：14012_myouji⟧/⟦{苗字|みょうじ}→苗字：noentry⟧ (surname)
・⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧ (business card)
・⟦{名詞|めいし}→名詞：10420_meishi⟧ (noun - grammar)
・⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧ (famous)
・⟦{無名|むめい}→無名：13420_mumei⟧ (unknown)

CONTRAST:
・{名|な} - literary, used in expressions
・⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧ - everyday word for 'name'
